scope: Static repair review of extraction containment, captured ZIP/build binding, and actual emitted author-kit validation. No helper, product, test, native, build, qualification, or network execution; no private database, authentication, configuration, archive or executable inspection.

resolved_findings.evidence: Lines 82-85 apply the existing local ancestor/reparse guard and resolved project containment before exclusive fresh installation creation; line 101 checks each extraction target.

Lines 25-37 admit the fixed canonical archive name and exact build/source identity, hash one protected captured byte snapshot, and use that snapshot for ZipFile(BytesIO). Lines 140-142 recheck the metadata and archive commitments.

Lines 39-63 verify the actual current canonical capability bytes, response statuses, canonical parsed manifest, exact payload lengths/hashes, actual E2 parsing and complete emitted payload inventory. Lines 137-138 recheck these previously captured kit commitments. Generated version metadata has the residual finding below.

findings.finding: The generated version.json is excluded from kit_closure and its final digest is compared only against another fresh read of the same current file. A version-only replacement after line 136 can change identity, archive_hash, financial_authority or the files inventory while both final closure comparisons still succeed and execution reaches passed=True.
findings.minimal_fix: Capture the exact intended serialized version bytes before writing. Require a protected final read of version.json to equal that captured snapshot and include its captured digest in the expected kit closure.
findings.minimal_regression: Replace only version.json after its exclusive write while leaving all capability, manifest and payload bytes unchanged; require refusal before passed=True.
